title: Senior HR Partner
description:
Who we are
 At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.
 Our dedication to remote-first work , and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
 .
 Hiring and how we work
 We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!
 Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
 .
 See yourself at Twilio
 Join the team as Twilio’s next Senior HR Partner.
 Who we are & why we’re hiring
 Twilio powers real-time business communications and data solutions that help companies and developers worldwide build better applications and customer experiences.
 Although we're headquartered in San Francisco, we have presence throughout South America, Europe, Asia and Australia. We're on a journey to becoming a global company that actively opposes racism and all forms of oppression and bias. At Twilio, we support diversity, equity & inclusion wherever we do business.
 About the job
 This position plays a key role in supporting the delivery of our People priorities across the organization. The role will support the GTM/Marketing organisation and will be an integral member of the HR Partner team.

title: Benefits Partner
location: Chicago, IL; Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY
description:
Join us in building the future of finance.
 Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.
 About the team + role
 We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.
 Robinhood’s People team builds the systems and programs that empower employees to do the best work of their careers, with Total Rewards focused on attracting, retaining, and motivating talent at every stage of their journey. Our Benefits team is small but mighty: we own the health, welfare, retirement, and leave programs employees rely on, and we keep them competitive. We're building something special, and we take that responsibility seriously!
 We're hiring a Benefits Partner to lead delivery of Robinhood's global health, welfare, retirement, and wellbeing programs. Reporting to the Head of Benefits, you'll shape strategy, drive renewals and vendor performance, lead leave of absence compliance in the US and abroad, and run benefits due diligence on acquisitions. You'll use data, automation, and AI to make sharper cost and plan design decisions and to scale as we enter new markets. This is a high-impact, highly visible role on a team where you'll build as much as you run.
 This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA, Chicago, IL and New York, NY offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

 About the job
 This position is needed to help build and scale Stytch’s core product as we bring Stytch capabilities to Twilio’s full customer base, delivering secure, developer-first identity experiences.
 Join the Stytch team at Twilio to shape the next generation of identity products. You’ll build backend systems that power authentication, authorization, and emerging agentic and non-human identity use cases. You’ll partner closely with product and engineering leadershp to design and deliver high-impact, customer-facing features, and evolve our platform for Twilio scale. This is a rare chance to operate like a startup within Twilio: you’ll work in a high-ownership environment with startup speed, backed by Twilio’s reach and scale.

title: Senior Product Designer II - Commerce & Retailer Platform
location: Canada - Remote (ON, AB, BC, or NS Only)
description:
We're transforming the grocery industry
 At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.
 Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.
 Instacart is a Flex First team
 There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.
 Overview
 Every day, millions of people use Instacart to get the essentials they need, and along the way they discover new ways to save and earn rewards. Our payments, loyalty, offers and retailer storefront teams power those moments, with a mission to make affordability and financial ease accessible to all through experiences that feel seamless and rewarding.
 Instacart powers grocery shopping in two ways: the Instacart marketplace, where customers shop across many retailers in one app, and a white-label product that lets retailers run their own branded storefronts, loyalty programs and offers on our technology. This role sits on the team that designs the shared building blocks behind both, including offers, loyalty, payments and savings modules that retailers configure to create their own store experiences.
